intro: Enabled channels receive notifications when tasks finish. Whether external channels are used is controlled by the notification preferences in account settings.

email.title: Email (SMTP)
email.description: Notifications are sent to the account email address.

webhook.title: Webhook
webhook.description: Push JSON to a custom HTTP endpoint.
webhook.testSuccess: Test request sent. Check your endpoint.
webhook.formatBody: POST sends the JSON below as the body; GET sends the same JSON in the data query parameter.
webhook.formatEvents: Events: task.succeeded, task.failed, task.partial_success, task.unknown; test requests use test.
webhook.formatSignature: With a secret, the X-EasySSH-Signature header is sha256= followed by the hex HMAC-SHA256(secret, raw body); GET requests sign the data parameter value. Verify the raw bytes received instead of re-serializing JSON.
webhook.formatDelivery: Requests time out after 10 seconds and non-2xx responses are retried. Deduplicate by data.event_id.
